job.title: Head of Marketing Fragrance & Beauty
job.jdText: At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL. About the role: The US F&B Head of Marketing is entrusted with shaping and elevating CHANELâs Brand Equity in the US, for the three strategic categories - Fragrance, Skincare and Makeup, in line with Global strategies and local market realities. This visionary leader can connect modernity with heritage, promote Brand saliency and desirability while helping drive data-informed, innovative and clientâcentric growth, in a marketing landscape shaped by AI, innovation and new possibilities. Our ideal candidate is attuned with the ever-changing rules of the US market and client journeys and energized by fostering deep emotional connections between the Brand, its existing and potential clients. This position orchestrates the full marketing ecosystem with a strategic mindset, inspiring and promoting a collaborative partnership with DCX, Brand Communication and Artistic Direction teams, locally and globally. Leading both Brand Management and Trade & Retail Marketing teams, this role ensures that every expression of the brand is coherent, elevated and culturally resonant, creating ultimate client experience at every touchpoint. What impact you can create at CHANEL: Brand Strategy and Brand Equity Stewardship Champion Chanelâs brand equity, ensuring all initiatives reflect the Houseâs heritage, creative vision, and uncompromising standards. Translate global brand strategies into locally relevant, highâimpact plans that reinforce CHANELâs local leadership in luxury fragrance and beauty, while in return promoting US market and client realities towards Global teams, to ensure that these specific needs are understood and translated into product and orchestration strategies. Be the voice of the Brand to communicate CHANELâs vision and support priorities to our Retailers and Market Teams, inspiring alignment and ambition. Category Expertise Across the Three Axis Demonstrate deep strategic and operational mastery of Fragrance, Skincare, and Makeup, understanding category dynamics, competitive landscapes, and client evolving motivations, to orchestrate locally relevant activations and nourish Global MTP product plans. Guide category teams to build longâterm equity while delivering shortâterm business performance, supervising and consolidating A&P budget by axis, facilitating prioritization and monitoring sales performance and ROI to adapt plans and investments in real time. Commission and interpret marketing intelligence, consumer research, competitive analysis, and trend forecasting to inform strategy. Translate customer data and market insights into articulated action plans by axis, govern implementation and measure success, with the support of the Transformation Office, Insights, Brand Comm (BC) and DCX teams. Connect the dots and lead the evolution from episodic insights to AI-augmented intuition, sensing cultural shifts and market opportunities. 360Â° Marketing Orchestration and Execution Conduct the orchestra, leading the endâtoâend development and implementation of integrated marketing campaigns, partnering closely with Brand Communication, Digital and Client Experience, Artistic Department and Retail teams, as well as Global partners. Beyond campaigns, ensure â with the support of the DCX and BC teams â that we create relevant and always-on connection across touchpoints of the clientâs journeys (events, digital activations, retail experiences, servicesâ¦), to convey the Houseâs storytelling through elevated and innovative multiâchannel expressions, elevating client lifetime value. Lead in a fluid world: operate in a composable marketing model where teams and skills reconfigure around outcomes, not just fixed roles. Client Journey & Experience Expertise Bring a sophisticated understanding of modern F&B client journeys across online and offline ecosystems for each product axis. Partner with DCX and Retail teams to ensure that every online and offline interactionâ from digital discovery, in-store experience, events or postâpurchase engagement â feels seamless and reflects the Houseâs signature level of service. Create unforgettable moments: together with the Artistic and Education teams, support the Retail to deliver extraordinary in-store and event experiences, consistent with Brandâs standards. Leverage insights and data to anticipate the expectations of the diverse US clientele (esp younger targets) and shape meaningful, personalized experiences for launches and core product offer. Leadership & Team Development Inspire, mentor, and develop highâperforming teams, nurturing curiosity and innovative spirit, accountability, and crossâfunctional collaboration. Foster a culture of operational excellence aligned with Chanelâs image and values, where team members also feel empowered to bring âout of the boxâ ideas to create Brand magic and unique story-telling. Lead with agility and promote simplification: guide an evolving organization, where roles continuously reconfigure as AIâs impact rises. Continuously assess what to automate, augment or eliminate, focusing teams on Brand priorities and high-value work. Partner with P&O to pilot adaptive organization principles when relevant. Strategic Partnership & Influence Develop strong relationships and trust with leaders of the rest of the marketing ecosystem (DCX, AD, Brand Comm) and collaborate with global and regional stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment and bestâinâclass execution. Represent the voice of the market: provide sharp insights to influence global strategy and innovation pipelines. You are energized by: Developing and executing strategic plans Setting lofty goals and achieving them Working in a highly collaborative environment Navigating complexity and supporting consistent transformation and change focusing on efficiency Collaborating with passionate teammates People leadership, coaching and development Creative problem solving and learning something new every day What you will bring to the team: Product sensibility across Fragrance, Makeup and Skincare with deep fluency in F&B brand equity building in a US competitive and diverse environment. Visionary and strategic thinker with strong executional discipline, able to think out of the box, bring the outside in and challenge conventions while honoring brand heritage and delivering exceptional client experience. Inspirational leader who attracts, develops and retains top talents. Deep cultural intuition and trend curiosity. Data-driven and able to transform insights into action plans Holistic expertise of the modern omni-channel client journey and the psychology of premium US consumers across age pyramid, as well as understanding of client-centric communication automation tools and growing impact of digital and AI on Marketing function. Strong financial acumen and budget management skills. Comfortable to lead by influence in complex environments, rely on centers of expertise (Brand Comm and DCX, Global teams) while challenging and connecting the dots. Position Logistics: Partially Remote: Role requires a minimum of three days in-person office presence at NYC office Minimum of 20 years of experience and 15+ years of specific marketing experience Strong analytical skills and the ability to synthesize data easily Experience leading teams and leaders of teams Bachelorâs degree required, Masterâs degree or MBA preferred Proficient use of Microsoft 365 programs is required Ability to travel internationally and domestically approximately 15% -20% or as business requires Exceptional written and verbal communication required with an understanding of French language preferable Compensation: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $256,100 through $400,000. We offer a unique work environment where individuals are encouraged to better understand the brand, the business, and motivations, so that together we can unlock the possibilities of growth. This is reflected in: Diversity and Inclusion: At CHANEL, we are intentional in promoting Diversity & Inclusion. We foster respect, empathy and dignity for all. We believe strongly that the diversity of our people across the full spectrum of human differences is essential to our organisation and the connections we have with each other and our clients. We offer Employee Resource Groups in the US that are voluntary, open to all, employee-led groups formed around a shared identity or lived experience, whose aim is to foster a diverse, inclusive, and equitable community aligned with the values and missions of the communities they support. Chanel Community: CHANEL Community empowers our employees to channel their passions, talents and sense of purpose to contribute to and learn from our communities. Employees are encouraged to take time off annually to volunteer through CHANEL Community. CHANEL also matches employee donations to select charitable organizations. Sustainability: CHANEL Mission 1.5Â° is our climate action plan. It is focused on transforming the business in line with the ambitions of the Paris Agreement on climate change to limit the average global mean temperature increase to 1.5 degrees Celsius above preindustrial levels. Employees are encouraged to contribute to our US Sustainability efforts at the corporate level and within the divisions, through organized taskforces and initiatives. Global support includes the CHANEL Culture Fund, which supports a select group of leading art culture institutions across the globe, and the CHANEL Next Prize for the next generation of creative talent. US support currently includes Annual sponsorship of the MoMA film program, Tribeca Film Festival programs and Through Her Lens, Support of the Academy Gold Fellowship for Women and Sponsorship of the BAAND Together Dance Festival at Lincoln Center. Fondation Chanel : Since 2011, Fondation CHANELâs mission is for women and girls to be free to shape their own destiny. Through multi-year partnerships with financial and technical support, Fondation CHANEL is committed to improving the safety and autonomy of women and adolescent girls around the world, impacting over a million women and girls in its first 10 years. In this role you will: In this role, you will: Support Users Provide expert, empathetic chat support to users, addressing both practical and emotional needs. Provide phone support to users, primarily via inbound calls, addressing scheduling needs, helping users to understand Empathyâs offerings, and answering logistical questions on accessing our support. Assist in creating detailed Care Plans for users.  Complete user requests related to closing accounts, funeral pricing and planning, sourcing vendors or professionals, and other various request types.  Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication, using the Empathy âvoiceâ. Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving abilities to resolve user challenges. Assist in the maintenance of the Care Team knowledge base and resources related to your role.  Act as a product expert who connects users to Empathy-specific tools and resources. Identify any gaps or opportunities for professional development training that can enhance both personal and team capabilities in providing an exceptional user experience. Relay user insights and identify knowledge gaps to support product development. Work With Precision and Independence Excel in organization, documentation, and time management to meet SLA requirements. Work as a team player across different functions and quickly adapt to assist with tasks as needed, reflecting the dynamic nature of our operations. Complete all training in a timely manner and provide feedback on training to ensure the team is continually improving the way information is shared.  Follow guidelines to escalate issues to the appropriate team member and operate with caution and care while working with sensitive user data. Engage in short-term projects that may vary based on the evolving needs of our business, as directed by management.
